lore: Safiya knows the buried springs that never appear on caravan maps. She has crossed the salt wastes with a single waterskin, and never once kept its last drop for herself.

name: Kassem, the Sunwall

name: Cinder-Mender Caldris
title: The Ember Kept for Others
lore: Caldris once tended the furnaces beneath the Seventh Pit, where mercy was counted as wasted fuel. Now her lantern burns for anyone still breathing, and the pitmasters follow its light with chains.
ability_desc: Restore 32% max HP to all living allies.

name: Theskar, the Hollow Gate
title: Last Watch of the Nameless Quarter
lore: When the Nameless Quarter slipped into shadow, its watchman held the evacuation gate until the last lantern crossed. Dawn found only his armor, still standing. Theskar no longer remembers the people he saved, but whenever footsteps flee through the dark, he turns his shield toward whatever follows.
ability_desc: Deal 150% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Isolde, the Last Foundry
title: Keeper of the Unquenched Heart
lore: When Valdur's furnaces went cold, Isolde carried their last living coal inside her own iron heart. She has crossed a century of battlefields rebuilding soldiers that kings had already written off. Her forge asks neither banner nor birthplace, only whether there is still someone inside the armor worth bringing home.

passive.desc: Immune to Decrease DEF. This permanent protection affects only Isolde.

ability_desc: Restore 32% max HP to all living allies.

name: Jade-Mender Baozhen
title: Physician of the Rainward Steps
lore: Baozhen left the imperial physicians after learning that medicine was reserved for officers. With a cracked jade bowl and a satchel of mountain herbs, he now walks the rainward steps between villages. The little dragon in his bowl was once offered a throne; it chose to help him carry water instead.
ability_desc: Restore 32% max HP to all living allies.

name: Carapace Warden Korr
title: The Specimen Who Kept the Names
lore: The alchemists recorded Korr as a number and called his growing shell a useful accident. He memorized every name scratched beneath the other cages before breaking the locks. Now he carries those names etched inside his armor, so that even the changed and forgotten can find someone who remembers them.
ability_desc: Deal 150% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Redknife Tavin
title: A Blade Below the Banquet
lore: Tavin spent ten years opening carriage doors for nobles who never learned his name. He learned theirs, and where their expensive armor leaves a seam. Now the servants of the lower court pay him in copper and safe beds, and no carriage passes their streets without permission.
ability_desc: Deal 237% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Vitriol Stalker Syth
title: The Greenhouse's Last Experiment
lore: Syth was bred to hunt escaped specimens through the glass gardens. Then a frightened child offered the hunter a name instead of a number. The handlers found their cages empty the next morning. Somewhere beyond the broken greenhouse, Syth is still learning which things deserve to be hunted.
ability_desc: Deal 237% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Rivet-Mender Orsa
title: One More Mile in the Machine
lore: Orsa fixes what the quartermasters mark beyond repair: cracked boilers, bent knees, and soldiers too tired to stand. She carries no commission and accepts no medals. When a warband reaches the next town alive, someone always finds a fresh copper rivet tucked into their coat.
ability_desc: Restore 32% max HP to all living allies.

name: Eira, the Hearthwarden
title: The Last Warm Light
lore: When the northern watchfires failed, Eira carried a coal from the last village hearth across the frozen fjord. Every door she reached opened to warmth, and every traveler behind her found the strength to keep walking. She still tends that coal, because the long night has not yet learned to end.
ability_desc: Restore 29% max HP to all living allies.

name: Shen, the Bronze Horizon
title: Warden of the Thousand-Step Pass
lore: Shen was ordered to close the mountain pass before the refugees arrived. Instead he planted his shield across the road and made the pursuing army wait. The court stripped him of his rank; the villages beyond the pass gave him a thousand doorways that would always open when he returned.
ability_desc: Deal 176% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Hadrian, the Walking Siege
title: The Breach That Walks
lore: Hadrian held the eastern siege line until the generals spent his last soldier. Rather than accept a replacement army, he ordered the surviving engineers to build the breach around him. His furnace still burns with the names of those who never came home, and no fortress has yet persuaded him to turn aside.

passive.name: Unbroken Advance
passive.desc: Hadrian is immune to Weaken. This permanent protection affects only him.

ability_desc: Deal 170% ATK damage to all living enemies.

name: Rimebow Tessa
title: Hunter of the Ice Road
lore: Tessa knows every safe crossing on the winter road and every sound the lake makes before it breaks. She used to hunt only to feed the waystations. Since the raiders came north, she has found that patience and a frost-tipped arrow can keep a caravan fed in other ways.
ability_desc: Deal 211% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Caravan Warden Samira
title: The Last Wagon Never Travels Alone
lore: Samira has never led a caravan. She rides beside its last wagon, where broken axles, exhausted camels and frightened children are easiest to leave behind. Her shield bears the route marks of seven deserts, and not one of them ends at an abandoned camp.
ability_desc: Deal 150% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Arcmaw Rhex
title: The Coil That Bit Back
lore: The academy fitted Rhex with copper teeth to measure how much lightning living bone could bear. Rhex answered by biting through the power cable. Now the escaped brawler follows the hum of laboratory generators, leaving dark windows and empty restraint chairs behind.
ability_desc: Deal 263% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Gallows Marksman Oren
title: One Bolt Before the Bell
lore: Oren once rang the execution bell above the lower court. The night an innocent family climbed the scaffold, he took down the crossbow reserved for escapees and turned it toward the guards. He still counts the bells before each shot, though he no longer waits for permission.
ability_desc: Deal 237% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Ulbrecht, the Veil Bastion
title: The Watch Beneath the Eclipse
lore: The old city paid its night watch in promises that the dawn would come. When an eclipse swallowed the final sunrise, Ulbrecht kept his post anyway. Travelers now follow the scrape of his shield through streets that maps refuse to remember, knowing the thing behind them will have to answer his challenge first.
ability_desc: Deal 176% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Kesh Duststep
title: Courier of the Broken Sunroad
lore: Kesh's black ear-tufts rise above every market crowd, usually just before the shouting starts. The caracal courier knows the buried paths between the scattered prides and carries their messages inside hollow knife handles. When the sunroad fell, he delivered every warning before asking who would pay him.
ability_desc: Deal 211% ATK damage to selected enemy, ignoring 25% of DEF.

name: Phaedra Dusktrail
title: The Path the Hunters Fear
lore: The smoky markings across Phaedra's puma shoulders look like the canyon shadows in which she grew up. She once guided trophy hunters to the high passes, until she discovered what they carried in their covered wagons. Now her arrows guide the prisoners home, and the hunters learn how far a scream travels in the dusk.
ability_desc: Deal 263% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Nima Dewthread
title: Tender of the Rain-Sewn Camps
lore: Nima sews names into the hems of the tents she repairs, so no lost traveler is ever only a stranger. Her clouded-leopard fur carries pale green whorls that brighten before rain. She learned her craft patching refugees rather than soldiers, and still insists that a healer's first duty is to leave someone a road home.
ability_desc: Restore 32% max HP to all living allies.

name: Sahri Sunspoke
title: The Racing Edge of Dawn
lore: Sahri's cheetah tear-marks fork into white sunbursts at her temples, a sign the old racers called a blessing. She won the dawn circuit with two broken sabers and gave the prize to the camps outside the walls. The arena masters still want their champion back; they have yet to catch her.
ability_desc: Deal 237% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Iridessa Snowglass
title: Knife of the High White Pass
lore: Blue threads run between the charcoal rosettes of Iridessa's snow-leopard coat, as though the mountain sky were caught beneath her fur. She guards the abandoned monastery road with daggers cut from its last unbroken window. The valley calls her an assassin; the children crossing the pass call her the lantern in the snow.
ability_desc: Deal 237% ATK damage to selected enemy, ignoring 25% of DEF.

name: Gromund Basalt-Mane
title: The Gate with a Living Heart
lore: Gromund braided the bronze gate-rings of his ruined city into his black lion's mane. When the survivors asked where they should build their next wall, he set down his shield and told them to begin behind him. The road is crowded now, and he has not moved.
ability_desc: Deal 150% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Rhazek Cinderstripe
title: Captain of the Ashen March
lore: Rhazek's tiger stripes glow red where the cinder temple fell across his arms. He carried its trapped defenders through the fire, then forged their broken blades into one great falchion. He marches beneath no conqueror's banner: the smoke behind him means a prison has opened.
ability_desc: Deal 165% ATK damage to all living enemies.

name: Vaelka, the Obsidian Watch
title: Guardian of the Moonless Stair
lore: Under moonlight, Vaelka's black panther fur reveals silver rosettes shaped like broken constellations. She keeps the stair beneath the ancestral observatory, where the oldest pride oaths are carved into glass. She has let thieves leave with treasures, but never let a pursuer follow a frightened guest.
ability_desc: Deal 176% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Anzuko, the Prism-Seer
title: Reader of the Shattered Day
lore: Anzuko's long lynx ear-tufts are threaded with tiny prisms, and his violet-gray fur bears pale geometric bands no scholar can explain. When the sun-prides shattered, he collected a fragment from every broken oath-stone. He studies their light for a future in which none of the prides must stand alone.
ability_desc: Restore 29% max HP to all living allies.

name: Azhar, the Rosetted Sun
title: Sovereign of the Unbroken Horizon
lore: Azhar's golden coat carries jaguar rosettes flowing into Bengal stripes, a pattern once dismissed as an impossible omen. Born outside every royal bloodline, he refused the sun-throne until its chains were melted into tools for the camps. The scattered prides follow him because he walks beside them, and because even an eclipse has never made him kneel.

passive.name: Sunscar Oath
passive.desc: Azhar is permanently immune to Weaken. This protection affects only him.

ability_desc: Deal 136% ATK damage to all living enemies.

name: Sivren, the Stillgrass Knife
title: Where the Grass Holds Its Breath
lore: Sivren learned to hear a bootstep through the roots before she learned the names of the scattered prides. The serval scout knots dry grass into her cloak and blackens the bronze sun at her throat, leaving nothing for a watchfire to catch. When slavers began marking the old sunroad, she followed their wagons without disturbing a seed head. By dawn, the cages stood open and every warning bell still slept. The freed travelers remember only amber eyes in the grass, and a quiet voice telling them which way led home.
ability_desc: Deal 252% ATK damage to selected enemy, ignoring 25% of DEF.

name: Nera, the Red Ledger
title: The Debt the Court Cannot Bury
lore: Nera kept the Bloodcourt's accounts until she found an entire village listed as an acceptable expense. She copied every name into a red ledger and took her fencing blade to the next banquet. The nobles call her a thief; their servants call her when another account needs settling.
ability_desc: Deal 213% ATK damage to selected enemy, ignoring 25% of DEF.

name: Belsorin Glassheart
title: Physician of the Unfinished
lore: Belsorin survived the procedure because another patient held the glass over his artificial heart until the seal set. He has spent every day since returning that favor. His conservatory clinic admits any creature that can find the door, and his charts begin with a name instead of a specimen number.
ability_desc: Restore 32% max HP to all living allies.

name: Suyin, Bell of the Monsoon
title: The Storm That Shelters
lore: Suyin rang the monsoon bell before the court gave permission, breaking a siege and a hundred years of drought in the same afternoon. The dragon scales at her temples have glowed jade ever since. She travels now with a smaller bell, offering villages the weather their rulers promised and never sent.
ability_desc: Restore 26% max HP to all living allies.

name: Tariq, the Glass Dervish
title: Dance of the Broken Oasis
lore: The conquerors turned Tariq's oasis to glass and thought the desert would forget it. He dug two blades from the cooling dunes and learned to make the ruined amphitheater sing beneath his feet. Now every caravan knows the flash of amber steel that appears when the tax riders draw too near.
ability_desc: Deal 165% ATK damage to all living enemies, ignoring 25% of DEF.

name: Hrolda, the Avalanche Door
title: Last Hinge of the Northern Holds
lore: When the avalanche took the walls, Hrolda tore the surviving fortress door from its hinges and carried it into the pass. Three villages crossed behind her before the snow settled. She wears its broken keys on her belt, so the holds will have something to open when their people finally return.
ability_desc: Deal 176% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Dagan Rivetstorm
title: The Factory's Final Warning
lore: Dagan designed the bolt-launcher to fix bridge plates without hanging workers over the furnace pits. The overseers ordered him to make it a weapon instead. He obliged, then tested the first production model on the locks of the workers' barracks. He still calls the recoil a manufacturing defect.
ability_desc: Deal 263% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Tali, Scrapshot
title: One Good Circuit Left
lore: Tali built her first crossbow from a hospital sign, three broken drones and the only working circuit in the scrap market. She sells protection to rooftop couriers for a meal and a battery charge. The syndicate keeps offering a contract; she keeps sending the contract back pinned to a dead security drone.
ability_desc: Deal 237% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Edrik Mournwall
title: Keeper of the Candle Gate
lore: Edrik remembers burying a soldier whose final request was that someone guard the candles. Death erased the soldier's name, but not the request. He carries a coffin lid where his old gate once stood, turning wandering horrors away from the small lights the living still leave behind.
ability_desc: Deal 150% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Venn Sablethread
title: Tailor of the Last Escape
lore: Venn stitched mourning clothes for families who could no longer afford to mourn. He began hiding escape maps in the lining, then silver needles in his sleeves. The city watch has learned to fear a tailor who measures the distance to every rooftop before he measures a coat.
ability_desc: Deal 237% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Oswin Briarhook
title: The Thorn at the Timber Road
lore: Oswin once marked trees for the royal timber road until he heard voices beneath the bark. His hook now tears the axle pins from the logging wagons, and the abandoned road grows narrower every spring. He keeps the last survey stake on his belt to remember how easily a straight line becomes a wound.
ability_desc: Deal 237% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Varya, the Stormbound Circuit
title: Blade of the Broken Grid
lore: Varya once maintained the private power lines above the frozen workers' quarter. When the owners ordered her to cut the heat, she wired the grid into her armor and turned its current against their guards. The city still follows the red lightning that marks her path.
ability_desc: Deal 260% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Iona, Signal Keeper
title: Lantern of the Rooftop Routes
lore: Iona repairs the signal lanterns that rooftop couriers leave for one another in the snow. Her small brass drones carry medicine where the Syndicate's gates stay shut. When the network falls silent, she lights the first safe route herself.
ability_desc: Restore 30% max HP to all living allies.

name: Morthane, the Last Lantern
title: Reaper of the Unburied Names
lore: Morthane carried the final lantern through a battlefield whose dead had been denied burial. Every forgotten name fed its green flame. He now opens that lantern before the armies that spend their soldiers carelessly, and the unburied answer.
ability_desc: Deal 155% ATK damage to all living enemies.

name: Vorga, Ashen Oath
title: Shield of the Furnace Exiles
lore: Vorga was forged to guard the furnace gates, not the prisoners behind them. She broke that oath when the youngest exile called her by name. Now her amber shield stands between the pitmasters and anyone who reaches the cold side of the gate.
ability_desc: Deal 165% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Velis, Moonroot Reaver
title: Hunter Beneath the Silver Boughs
lore: The moonroot grew around the first oath-stone that an invading king broke. Velis rose from its branches with the names of every felled grove carved beneath their bark. Beneath the silver boughs, a conqueror's promises no longer offer shelter.
ability_desc: Deal 250% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Rosamund, Emberleaf Tender
title: Healer of the Returning Grove
lore: Rosamund returned to a grove reduced to charcoal and found one red leaf still warm in the ashes. She sheltered it in a copper bowl until roots began to grow through the burn. Her healing fire carries that first leaf from camp to camp, leaving green shoots where the wounded rested.
ability_desc: Restore 28% max HP to all living allies.

name: Nayara, Keeper of the Deep Well
title: Voice of the Buried River
lore: Nayara refused the pearl throne while a single caravan still searched for water. The buried river answered by lifting its oldest well into the moonlight. Wherever she walks, its blue current washes poison from the weary and carries them one crossing farther from the desert's hunger.

passive.name: Heart of the Deep Well
passive.desc: Restore 3% of Nayara's maximum HP at the start of each board move.

ability_desc: Restore 24% max HP to all living allies.

name: Qadir, Glassveil Warden
title: Keeper of the Unbroken Caravan
lore: Qadir makes his armor from glass left behind when lightning strikes the dunes. Each violet plate remembers a blow that failed to reach the caravan behind him. Raiders see a dozen wardens in its reflections; the travelers know that one has always been enough.
ability_desc: Deal 130% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Thalen, Mossveil Hunter
title: Stalker of the Forgotten Streets
lore: Thalen remembers every door that vanished when the old quarter slipped into shadow. Moss has grown through his armor, but his knives still find the hinges of a false refuge. He follows those who hunt the lost, leaving their borrowed protections hanging open behind them.
ability_desc: Deal 225% ATK damage to selected enemy, ignoring 25% of DEF.

name: Sabine, Candle of the Lost
title: Warden of the Borrowed Dawn
lore: Sabine lights a candle for every traveler who disappears beneath the veil. She carries their flames through the ruined streets, forming a doorway no pursuing shade may cross. When her own light falters, the candles she once sheltered gather to lift it again.

passive.name: Borrowed Dawn
passive.desc: Revive once per battle at 20% maximum HP.

ability_desc: Empower your warband with the effects below.

name: Zareen, Ember-Pride Huntress
title: Spear of the Open Sunroad
lore: Zareen learned to hunt in the red dust beyond the sun-prides' walls. When tribute riders began taking children instead of coin, she lit their tax banners with her spear. The camps still follow the ember trail that leads around the princes' gates.
ability_desc: Deal 220% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Kharuun, Rimeclaw Bastion
title: Shield of the High Snowroad
lore: Kharuun keeps the mountain crossing that the lowland courts declared impossible to defend. Snow gathers in the rosettes of his coat while caravans pass beneath his bronze shield. Those who come to close the road learn that every traveler behind him has a claw ready to answer.
ability_desc: Deal 105% ATK damage to all living enemies.

name: Valcera, Briar Magistrate
title: The Court's Unwritten Sentence
lore: Valcera knows which verdicts are written before the accused enters the hall. She keeps a second record in the thorns beneath the magistrates' gardens. At the next banquet, a green stain on the wine is the only warning that their own sentence has arrived.
ability_desc: Deal 260% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Skeldra, the Night Aurora
title: Hunter Beyond the Last Watchfire
lore: Skeldra follows the violet lights beyond the northern watchfires, where even the winter road loses its name. Her black-ice bow stores the silence between aurora pulses. She can loose one arrow at the first sign of pursuit, or wait until the entire sky answers with her.
ability_desc: Deal 205% ATK damage to all living enemies.

name: Hanrui, River-Scale Spear
title: Lancer of the Rainward Steps
lore: Hanrui was ordered to hold a river bridge against farmers fleeing the imperial levy. He lowered his spear for the refugees and raised it when the officers followed. The river has bent around his blade ever since, opening a crossing where a wall was meant to stand.
ability_desc: Deal 250% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Torvek, the Void Battery
title: Gunner of the Silent Foundry
lore: A breach in an Ironclad furnace left Torvek deaf to cannon fire and able to hear the void between heartbeats. He sealed the breach inside his siege cannon. Now he marches at the head of the foundry columns, firing silent shells that strip the strength from enchanted armor.
ability_desc: Deal 220% ATK damage to selected enemy, ignoring 25% of DEF.

name: Kaitha, Caldera Fury
title: The Crucible Unbound
lore: The Chymera called the living crucible a failed experiment until Kaitha climbed from it carrying its shattered chains. Obsidian scales now protect her skin, and molten light runs through her altered arms. She hunts the architects of the experiment, turning their fortresses into the furnaces they once built for her.
ability_desc: Deal 160% ATK damage to all living enemies.

name: Lysandre, Winter Vein
title: Duelist of the Frozen Court
lore: While the Bloodcourt feasted through a winter siege, Lysandre kept watch beside its frozen gates. He learned to draw heat from spilled blood and set it like blue crystal along his rapier. Courtiers still mistake his patience for mercy. In a duel, each measured step closes another path of escape.
ability_desc: Deal 255% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Cressida, Ashen Veil
title: Knife Beneath the Embers
lore: Cressida was sent through an Umbra gate that opened inside a burning shrine. She returned with embers trapped in her shadow and no reflection in firelight. The veil now carries her between dying flames, where her knives leave wounds that no fresh blessing can close.
ability_desc: Deal 250% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Zhenya, Sun-Dragon Lancer
title: Spear of the First Dawn
lore: Before the eastern bells announce dawn, Zhenya is already riding the high causeways of the Dragon Dynasty. Her sun-forged spear carries the oath of the first imperial guard: strike before darkness gathers its strength. She serves no throne blindly, judging every ruler by the people sheltered beneath it.
ability_desc: Deal 165% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Yaqut, Emerald Talon
title: Hunter of the Venom Dunes
lore: Yaqut follows the green-winged falcons that nest above the Dune Riders’ hidden wells. Their venom is harmless to those who know its remedy, a secret he shares with every caravan under his protection. Raiders learn a different lesson when an emerald feather falls across their path.
ability_desc: Deal 220% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Nix, Biosteel Hunter
title: Blade of the Living Circuit
lore: When a Neon Syndicate weapons program grew a nervous system of its own, Nix cut herself free from its command lattice. Living filaments now repair her railblade between strikes. She stalks the syndicate towers as both hunter and evidence, carrying every stolen memory the program tried to erase.
ability_desc: Deal 270% ATK damage to selected enemy, ignoring 25% of DEF.

name: Draeven, Gravefrost Headsman
title: The Last Sentence
lore: Draeven once kept the names of the Nether’s condemned carved into his axe. When the dead began whispering those names back, he bound their voices beneath gravefrost. He now walks the necropolis roads, delivering the sentences that even its abyssal lords hoped time would forget.
ability_desc: Deal 265% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Melia, Dawn-Pollen Mender
title: Keeper of the Waking Blooms
lore: Melia gathers the first pollen to rise from Wildgrove’s golden flowers each morning. Carried in her woven lantern, it clears the fever of thorn wounds and wakes exhausted travelers. She has never held a royal title, yet every path through the grove bears a small shrine to her kindness.
ability_desc: Restore 24% max HP to all living allies.

name: Nyrali, Moon-Pride Keeper
title: Voice of the Night Ancestors
lore: Nyrali keeps the names of the Veldtborn ancestors braided into silver rings along her mane. Beneath the purple moons, their spirits answer her song and walk beside the living. She leads scattered prides across the night grasslands, making every camp a place where the lost can finally rest.
ability_desc: Restore 25% max HP to all living allies.

name: Haska, Hearth Guard
title: Shield of the Last Fire
lore: When winter swallowed her village, Haska carried its final hearth-coal inside her iron shield. Every settlement she defended added another ember to the flame. Frost raiders call her a walking bonfire; the families behind her shield simply call her home.
ability_desc: Deal 130% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Orrix, Amethyst Bulwark
title: The Patient Mutation
lore: The Chymera bred Orrix to survive the pressure beneath their crystal mines. Amethyst plates grew across his back, but the miners discovered a patient guardian beneath the experiment. When the tunnels collapsed, he held the ceiling until the last worker escaped. He has guarded their refuge ever since.
ability_desc: Deal 125% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Othrel, Riverstone Aegis
title: Warden of the Unbroken Current
lore: Othrel slept beneath Wildgrove’s oldest river until poisoned water reached the roots above his cairn. Now the river walks in stone, carrying its clear current between villages threatened by fire and blight. Every shield he raises remembers the shape of a sheltered shore.
ability_desc: Deal 110% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Domitrix, the Gilded Vigil
title: Keeper of the Bloodcourt Oath
lore: The Bloodcourt entrusted Domitrix with its treasury and discovered that she guarded its oaths more fiercely than its gold. Her gilded shield breaks borrowed enchantments, exposing the mortal weakness beneath a rival’s finery. Even the court’s eldest nobles lower their voices when her watch begins.
ability_desc: Deal 130% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Beatrice, Verdigris Mender
title: Hands Behind the Iron Line
lore: Beatrice learned that an Ironclad warband could survive a shattered engine but not a crew left behind. Her verdigris tinctures seal wounds as readily as cracked armor, while her clockwork assistants carry clean bandages through the smoke. She measures every invention by how many soldiers return home.
ability_desc: Restore 24% max HP to all living allies.

name: Ephoros, Pale Ferryman
title: Lantern of the Drowned Roads
lore: Across the Nether’s drowned roads, Ephoros ferries souls who still remember their living names. His lantern guides the wounded away from the grasping dead, and his pale wake keeps curses from crossing behind them. He asks no coin, only that those he saves carry another traveler when their strength returns.
ability_desc: Restore 22% max HP to all living allies.

name: Cassio, Gravity Knife
title: The Distance Thief
lore: Cassio stole a gravity lens from a Neon Syndicate vault and fitted it into the hilt of a knife. Since then, locked doors and long distances have become matters of opinion. He strikes where a target’s armor pulls hardest, leaving syndicate enforcers arguing over which shadow moved first.
ability_desc: Deal 230% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Pyrrhon, the Soulfire Verdict
title: Bearer of the Prison Sun
lore: A dead sun burns inside the prison bell that Pyrrhon carries through the Nether. Each sentence he speaks draws one captive flame into his blade. He reserves the brightest fire for tyrants who have hidden behind stolen blessings, returning their borrowed power to the silent dead.
ability_desc: Deal 245% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Inko, Plasma Skirmisher
title: Runner Beyond the Barricades
lore: Inko ran messages through the Neon Syndicate’s barricades before learning what those orders cost the people outside. Now her plasma sabers cut supply locks and disable patrol armor. The red trail she leaves across the snow has become a promise that another route will open.
ability_desc: Deal 215% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Hester, Emberthorn Hunter
title: Keeper of the Sleeping Fire
lore: Hester tends the emberthorn groves where Wildgrove’s old fires sleep beneath living bark. She gathers their glowing seeds into arrowheads, using their heat to drive invasive blight from the forest’s borders. No flame she kindles is allowed to burn longer than the grove can bear.
ability_desc: Deal 225% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Kozhak, Glacier Prowler
title: Hunter Beneath the Whiteout
lore: Kozhak follows the glacier herds along the Veldtborn’s highest migration paths. He waits through storms that bury entire hunting parties, trusting the tremor of the ice to betray a hidden enemy. When he finally moves, the whiteout itself seems to spring forward with his blades.
ability_desc: Deal 260% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Ushala, Quillgrass Tracker
title: Guide of the Thorn Paths
lore: Ushala reads the grasslands by the quills left in their thorny seed heads. Her people once mistook that patient craft for timidity, until she guided a scattered pride through an army without losing a traveler. Now her barbed darts mark the paths no pursuer should follow.
ability_desc: Deal 225% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Qingluo, Jade Tempest
title: Storm of the Bamboo Sea
lore: Qingluo trained where the Dragon Dynasty’s jade mountains rise above an endless bamboo sea. He learned to turn a single sweeping strike into the rhythm of a storm, breaking an enemy line without taking a backward step. The imperial banners call him a weapon; his mountain village remembers the boy who defended its bridge.
ability_desc: Deal 165% ATK damage to all living enemies.

name: Thyssara, Eclipse Blade
title: The Veil’s Stolen Dawn
lore: Thyssara stole a strand of sunlight from a failing Umbra gate and wound it along her sword. The veil has hunted her ever since, unable to decide whether that captured light is a wound or a key. She uses it to cut the enchantments binding others to the dark, then disappears before anyone can call her a savior.
ability_desc: Deal 250% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Alkyron, Starbreaker
title: Starbreaker
lore: The Astral Concord remembers Alkyron’s twelve labors as twelve dead worlds pulled back into orbit. He wears their shattered moons as a belt and carries a lion-shaped nebula across his shoulders. When another sun threatens to fall, he meets it with his bare hands.
ability_desc: Deal 190% ATK damage to all living enemies.

name: Ruxil, Cinder Newt
title: Cinder Newt
lore: Ruxil hatched in the cooling shell of a wandering meteor. The Concord found him stealing sparks from its engines and offered him a place beside its navigators. He now guards the fleet’s wake, scorching anything that follows too closely.
ability_desc: Deal 220% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Eudoma, Nova Keeper
title: Nova Keeper
lore: Eudoma tends the small captive star at the heart of the Concord’s oldest ark. Its warmth has sustained generations born between worlds, and she carries a fragment into every battle. Those who stand beside her remember that even the longest journey can lead home.
ability_desc: Restore 26% max HP to all living allies.

name: Asterox, Labyrinth Moon
title: Labyrinth Moon
lore: Asterox was bred to hunt prisoners through a moon-sized labyrinth. He broke its central gate instead, guiding its captives into the Concord’s waiting ships. He still carries that gate as a shield, refusing to let another maze close around the helpless.
ability_desc: Deal 135% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Nerephon, Tide Singer
title: Tide Singer
lore: Nerephon charts the invisible tides that flow between planets. His songs guide damaged vessels through those currents, easing pain and scattering the sickness carried by cold starlight. Concord pilots say they can hear him even through a broken helm.
ability_desc: Restore 21% max HP to all living allies.

name: Thalassor, Orbit Spear
title: Orbit Spear
lore: Thalassor once ruled the storm oceans of a world whose sun had vanished. He joined the Concord when its arks brought light back to his people. His trident now bends the deep sky into currents strong enough to tear a warship from its course.
ability_desc: Deal 230% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Kelydras, Worldbearer
title: Worldbearer
lore: An entire orchard grows across the shell of Kelydras, preserved from the world he could not save. He carries its last seeds between the Concord’s arks, planting wherever life can take root. In battle, he shelters his companions as carefully as that fragile forest.
ability_desc: Empower your warband with the effects below.

name: Xiphae, Comet Huntress
title: Comet Huntress
lore: Xiphae tracks the silent predators that drift behind the Concord’s harvest ships. She marks their paths with arrows grown from living comet stone. Her quarry rarely sees the huntress, only the green trail that turns suddenly toward it.
ability_desc: Deal 225% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Ophira, Seed of Worlds
title: Seed of Worlds
lore: Ophira carries a seed that flowers only beneath an unfamiliar sky. From its roots she draws the strength to sustain settlers through barren seasons and strange plagues. The Concord follows her blooms from world to world, leaving gardens where there had been only dust.
ability_desc: Restore 26% max HP to all living allies.

name: Ixanth, Solar Wing
title: Solar Wing
lore: Ixanth built his wings from the wreckage of the Concord’s first solar sail. Where his teachers saw a reckless ascent, he saw a route through the enemy’s siege. His wings have burned a hundred times; each return teaches him how to fly closer to the light.
ability_desc: Deal 250% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Qamuret, Riddle Guard
title: Riddle Guard
lore: Qamuret guards the Concord’s oldest archive, asking every visitor what they intend to leave behind. Her riddles test kindness rather than cleverness. Against those who answer with violence, she becomes as immovable as the golden doors at her back.
ability_desc: Deal 115% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Phozia, Star Oracle
title: Star Oracle
lore: Phozia reads possible futures in the dust caught inside her halo. She cannot promise victory, but she can find the instant when a shield will matter most. The Concord trusts her because she speaks plainly about what even the stars cannot know.
ability_desc: Restore 22% max HP to all living allies.

name: Gorgythe, Prism Gaze
title: Prism Gaze
lore: Gorgythe’s living crown sees the fractures hidden inside armor and stone. Once feared as a monster, she now scouts shattered worlds for the Concord, finding survivors beneath impossible ruins. Her enemies learn that a single glance can expose what brute force never could.
ability_desc: Deal 240% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Zazikul, Silk Weaver
title: Silk Weaver
lore: Zazikul spins silk strong enough to anchor a ship to an asteroid. When raiders threatened the Concord’s nursery ark, he stitched their engines into a single helpless knot. His quiet work has held the fleet together ever since.
ability_desc: Deal 220% ATK damage to selected enemy.

name: Kheiraxis, Void Gallop
title: Void Gallop
lore: Kheiraxis races along the thin paths between collapsing portals. He carries messages that no ship can deliver, reaching isolated Concord outposts before their last lights fail. His spear closes the false gates that lure travelers into the dark.
ability_desc: Deal 225% ATK damage to selected enemy.
